reasons: CS2109S prerequisite requires MA1511+MA1512 or MA1521 or MA2002 or MA1102R or MA1312 or MA1507 or MA1505. None are completed or planned, and no math course is offered in Sem 1 to satisfy this prerequisite for CS2109S in Sem 1.
CS2109S prerequisite also requires YSC2229 or CS2040S/C/HS/DE/0. YSC2229 is not offered. CS2040 variants require CS1010 and CS1231/MA1100. These cannot be completed before Sem 1.

CS2103T requires CS2030 and CS2040. CS2030 requires CS1010. CS2040 requires CS1010 and CS1231/MA1100. These foundational courses are not completed, making CS2103T in Sem 6 impossible without prior planning which conflicts with the Sem 1 CS2109S constraint.
